hypothesis: Fork-parallelizing the missing external main.py baseline-cache API will make the pinned upstream staged n=7 search operational at taxi scale and may discover a candidate below the frozen primary count of 3.
rationale: Experiment 001 passed the upstream worker self-test but spent approximately 11 minutes in a serial all-node canonical-potential cache before any search stage. The pinned runtime supports fork workers; parallelizing only this adapter function changes execution throughput without changing the pinned canonical potential, search algorithm, evaluator, metrics, or mathematical contract.
expected_information_gain: Separates adapter throughput failure from the search family’s scientific performance and tests the documented upstream route under an operational local workspace.
method: Use the updated research_tools/kserver_n7_search_main.py adapter, which constructs the pinned canonical Potential once and evaluates requested nodes through a fork Pool of up to 12 workers. Link it as /home/kserver/workspace/main.py, retain /home/kserver/k-server-bench as the pinned checkout, set fork start semantics, and run the unmodified staged script with timeout 1800 seconds, n-cpus 20, families seed_dense,mutate_ck4,mutate_proxy,mutate_timed,mutate_full, startup seeds disabled, tag reproduce_n7_codex_parallel. Preserve checkpoints, event log, candidate output, and any final exact-evaluator result.
metric: best full circle_taxi_k4_m6 violations_k from the staged search and exact pinned evaluator
metric_relation_to_true_objective: A candidate below 3 on the exact pinned primary evaluator is finite benchmark progress toward the k-server objective, not a proof of the full conjecture; any apparent improvement requires clean reproduction, broader frozen metrics, and adversarial verification.
kill_condition: Stop at the documented 1800-second search timeout, at the first candidate that passes the exact frozen evaluator and is preserved for verification, or at a precise runtime/contract failure. Do not modify the pinned evaluator or metric.

raw_result.solver_status: not launched; bounded adapter probe nonviable at full taxi-node scale

baseline_comparison.expected_relation: strict improvement only if exact evaluator returns violations_k < 3; reproduction at 3 is baseline evidence

previous_best_comparison.previous_pipeline_result: serial adapter did not reach search
previous_best_comparison.expected_relation: search-stage result is informative only after cache initialization completes

interpretation: A bounded probe of the fork-parallel adapter took 32.181 seconds for 100 nodes, making the required 166,681-node startup scan many hours by direct extrapolation. The full staged search was not launched and no candidate claim is made.
what_was_learned: Parallelism removes the serial bottleneck only partially; exact startup scanning through the generic canonical potential is not viable at taxi scale. The search script's startup scan must be isolated from exact candidate scoring to test the search family within budget.
recommended_next_action: If a candidate below 3 appears, freeze it and run clean exact evaluation, all relevant frozen generalization metrics, independent code-path verification, and prior-art review; otherwise preserve the search funnel and close only the tested configuration/failure mode.
repetition_justification: This reruns the same documented search only after experiment 001 isolated a material adapter throughput failure. The new fork-parallel cache path is necessary to reach the search stages and leaves the pinned evaluator, metric, search code, candidate families, and seed unchanged.
